title: Aimbot Esp Hitbox Expander Skin Changer Updated
features:
Aimbot: Automatically locks your crosshair onto targets for precise shooting.
Triggerbot: Fires automatically the instant an enemy crosses your crosshair.
Hitbox Expander: Enlarges the target area around enemy models, making shots easier to land.
ESP (Extra-Sensory Perception): Displays enemy positions, health, and equipment through walls.
Skin Changer: Unlocks and modifies weapon or character cosmetics locally.
Bunny Hop: Automates continuous jumping to maintain maximum movement speed.
Smoothing: Moderates aimbot movements to appear more natural and human-like.
